rows.rationale: Executed natively on the ubuntu-24.04-arm runner (arm64 kernel and toolchain; no cross-compilation, no QEMU — the native-image gate verifies uname -m and RUNNER_ARCH and rejects any registered qemu-aarch64 binfmt handler). rows.evidence: package-release assembles x86_64-unknown-linux-musl archive (compiled sidecar plus pinned musl Bun runtime + pi-extension-host.js fallback staged beside pi) and unpack smoke verifies pi --version + compiled-sidecar hello handshake; packaging/protocol scope only — no PTY/render/synchronized-output/no-clear claims
rows.rationale: Musl packaging/protocol witness required on the local x86_64 host. Prerequisites: the musl C toolchain (musl-gcc, apt musl-tools/musl-dev or the REL-R1 relocated prefix) for the cargo build, and the Alpine musl userland for the smoke — Alpine minirootfs loader installed at /lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 with /etc/ld-musl-x86_64.path pinned to the isolated libstdc++/libgcc userland; missing either fails the row on the named prerequisite. Not a Tier N terminal-conformance row — zero interaction steps.

rows.evidence: aarch64-linux-musl packaging/protocol lane is not run on the x86_64 linux dev host; CI witness is the native musl leg on ubuntu-24.04-arm (musl-gcc build, static-link/interpreter/archive-integrity gates, transcript_musl_smoke packaging/protocol lane) — no PTY/render/synchronized-output/no-clear claims
rows.rationale: Executed natively on the ubuntu-24.04-arm runner: the arm64 kernel runs the aarch64 musl artifacts under the provisioned Alpine arm64 userland (ld-musl-aarch64.so.1), with no cross-compilation and no QEMU — the native-image gate verifies uname -m and RUNNER_ARCH and rejects any registered qemu-aarch64 binfmt handler. The x86_64 dev host provides neither arm64 execution nor an aarch64 musl userland, so the leg is excluded locally.
rows.citation: scripts/release/targets.ts RUST_TARGETS includes aarch64-unknown-linux-musl; release-verification.yml maps aarch64-unknown-linux-musl to ubuntu-24.04-arm with the Alpine minirootfs arm64 userland (ld-musl-aarch64.so.1)
